clues.text: In Eden, after eating the forbidden fruit, Adam and Eve sewed its leaves together to cover themselves.
Hungry on the road into Jerusalem, Jesus found only leaves on this tree, and it withered at once.
Jesus told Nathanael He had seen him under this tree before Philip ever called him.
Jesus taught that when this tree's branches turn tender and sprout leaves, you know summer is near.
In a parable of Jesus, a man found no fruit on this tree in his vineyard for three years.
In Jotham's story on Mount Gerizim, this tree would not be king over the trees and give up its sweetness.
In Solomon's peaceful days, each man in Judah and Israel lived securely under his own vine and this tree.
